# Brew

> Brew is a local-first, single-user RSS reader with deterministic rules and frozen daily digest snapshots. It runs as one Node.js process and stores feeds, articles, rules, settings, and snapshots in one local SQLite file.

Official source: https://github.com/tanzir71/brew
Interactive canned demo: https://tanzir71.github.io/brew/demo/

## Product facts

- No account, hosted database, subscription, or telemetry.
- The computer running Brew must be on for scheduled fetching.
- Phone access is available over the user's own local network.
- Backup means stopping Brew and copying data/brew.db.
- OPML import/export is supported.
- A Brew is an immutable daily snapshot assembled from user-configured sections and rules.
- The public demo uses canned data and does not fetch feeds or persist data.
